name: First Tiptoe
tip: Push the monkey down onto the banana. Avoid tiles next to the sloth.

name: Straight Shot
tip: Leaves are silent and twigs are loud, but you don't need either here. Just push.

name: Around the Corner
tip: Push the monkey right, then get above it and push it down.

name: The Quiet Detour
tip: The shortcut crunches on a dry twig. The long way over the leaves is silent.

name: Two Monkeys, One Nap
tip: Stand in the middle and push one monkey each way.

name: Leafy Lullaby
tip: The leaves on the lower path are silent. Keep your pushes short and steady.

name: Twiggy Business
tip: One twig lies in the straight route. A detour may be quieter, if you can get behind the monkey.

name: A Sloth-Sized Detour
tip: The sloth blocks the direct approach. Walk around before lining up behind the monkey.

name: Banana Backtrack
tip: The monkey is between you and its banana. Push it left, one careful step at a time.

name: The Quiet Encore
tip: Two monkeys, two bananas. Stand between the monkeys, then plan each push.
